finding: Both inherited uscode.house.gov 'granuleid:USC-prelim-...' URLs for 26 USC 988 and 31 USC 5321 were fetched on 2026-11-09 and returned 'Page Not Found'.
disposition: Edition I uses govinfo.gov US Code 2024 edition pages, which were retrieved successfully; the two dead URLs and their replacements are recorded in research/known-dead-ends.md.

finding: The FinCEN URL 'https://www.fincen.gov/reporting-international-transportation-currency-monetary-instruments' in an inherited source registry returns 'Page Not Found'.
disposition: Edition I cites a retrieved CBP newsroom page for the USD 10,000 / FinCEN 105 rule.

finding: The Changsha Customs Q&A URL (customs.gov.cn/changsha_customs/.../1316760/index.html) used in earlier editions returns HTTP 404.
disposition: Edition I uses a retrieved GACC consultation answer plus the GACC service guide.

finding: Several editions present the 2004 three-stage emigration release as current law.
disposition: Corrected against SAFE Huifa [2014] No.2 §VI(2), retrieved from SAFE's own site.

finding: USD 50,000 is repeatedly described as an absolute annual ceiling on all individual FX purchases.
disposition: The official gazette distinguishes a convenience quota (Art. 54) from documented non-quota current-account purchases (Art. 56), confirmed by a 2026 SAFE Q&A.

finding: USD 50,000/day remittance threshold and USD 50,000/year purchase quota are conflated in several inherited tables.
disposition: Separated with the exact Arts. 54 / 64 / 65 citations.

finding: BOC board rates from 2026-11-08 are carried forward without the bank's 仅供参考 disclaimer.
disposition: Edition I re-retrieved the board (2026-11-09 09:15:45) and states it is not an executable quote.

finding: Earlier editions cite a 2025-03 BOC tariff PDF although the price-list index now links a 2025-11-11 edition.
disposition: Edition I uses the current PDF; both editions' cross-border TT figures were read and are identical for item 210105008.

finding: Inherited Wise quote URLs are presented as a price grid, but the provider's own guide caps a single bank-app transfer at CNY 300,000 and ties the overall limit to tax records.
disposition: Edition I publishes only four directly observed quotes and leaves the rest blank.

finding: Inherited material sometimes treats the 1% US remittance tax as applying to inbound China→US wires.
disposition: Corrected with IR-2026-48, which limits it to US-origin, physical-instrument-funded remittances.

finding: The HSBC China tariff PDF contains tables of two different effective dates.
disposition: Disclosed and restricted to the top-level 2026-10-31 tariff.

finding: PRC savings-interest exemption and US worldwide-income taxation are sometimes merged into a single 'no tax' claim.
disposition: Separated: PRC IIT on savings interest is temporarily exempt; US taxation of worldwide income continues.

finding: The repeal of the foreign-individual dividend exemption effective 2026-09-01 is absent from most inherited tax tables.
disposition: Added with the official MOF/STA announcement republication.

finding: FBAR penalty maxima in inherited tables are the unadjusted statutory figures.
disposition: Added the eCFR inflation-adjusted table figures, with the assessment-date caveat.

finding: The 2013 tax-filing announcement is cited as if wholly current, although 2021 No.19 repealed several articles.
disposition: Both instruments are cited with the repeal noted.
